skills/looks-good-to-ai.description: Code review skill for pull requests and diffs written by AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor). Use it when reading every line no longer scales, or when the code looks clean but you don't trust it yet. Splits "reading the code" into three separate jobs (catch bugs, align context, own the sign-off) and runs a different process for each. Use for requests like "review this AI-generated PR", "can this diff be merged", "too many agent PRs to review", "check this before I approve", or "what should I verify before signing off".
